entries.name: UFO (flying saucer)
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, colour map flattened (Kenney Tower Defense Kit)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: The plan's pack (Kenney Tower Defense Kit, zip pinned by sha256), but `enemy-ufo-c` instead of the plan's `enemy-ufo-a`. All four kit saucers (a, b, c, d) were rendered: a is squat with a raised turret collar, b has a green bumper ring, d is a stacked double disc; c is the classic flying saucer (a wide, thin faceted disc, a raised ring and a big dome) and reads best. Also compared Quaternius Ultimate Spaceships (May 2021, OpenGameArt, used by the `spaceship` entry): its only disc ship, Pancake, is a gunship with a fighter cockpit, not a classic saucer. Real size: a film flying saucer is about 8-12 m across; at a 5.2 m rest height (dome top) this model is 9.9 m across. Bottom of the belly at y = 0 (films lift it). Kenney ships every triangle twice, back to back, so `ingest.dropBackfaces` removes the inward copies (440 -> 220 tris); otherwise their ink hulls paint the surface black. The colour map is flattened to 5 colours: silver disc panels -> hull (moon over sky), the purple disc panels and rim -> lights (indigo accent red over sky), the darker raised ring and belly -> metal (line over sky), the white dome and its collar -> dome (practical amber over iris, a lit canopy for a night sky). Kept faceted (`smooth: false`). Static, no clips.
